source: TotalSegmentator MRI dataset v3.0.0, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22688334 (CC BY 4.0), subject s0175, label spinal_cord
method: TotalSegmentator MRI dataset v3.0.0 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22688334, CC BY 4.0), subject s0175 (whole body), label "spinal_cord", as stored by tools/imaging_fmri_body.py (RAS, z,y,x). The mask surface is extracted with marching cubes (scikit-image). Each vertex is stored as (t, right_mm, anterior_mm): t = position along the cord's own centre line (0 = top, 1 = bottom, by arc length), and the offset from that centre line. The app places it along the central canal of the BodyParts3D body, so the cross-section is this MRI subject's and the course is the reference body's: an approximate fit.
